headline: Insurance AI firm Kalepa raises $75 million in Series B funding
body: Insurance AI firm Kalepa has raised $75 million in Series B funding at a $470 million valuation, Finextra reports. It looks to expand its AI platform across the insurance value chain and into new markets.
note: Underwriting is one of the insurance functions where AI vendors are now raising growth capital, so carriers may see more platforms pitching across the value chain.
